symptom: my LED is wired between 3.3V and the GPIO pin (active-low). The code sets the pin HIGH to turn it on, but the LED stays off and lights when I set it LOW. The pin number is correct (BCM17).

files.led.py:
from gpiozero import LED
from time import sleep
led = LED(17)
while True:
    led.on()
    sleep(0.5)
    led.off()
    sleep(0.5)

gold.diagnosis: The LED is wired active-low (anode to 3.3V, cathode to the GPIO pin through a resistor). A plain gpiozero LED drives active-high, so on() drives the pin HIGH and the LED is off. Use LED(17, active_high=False) so on() drives the pin LOW and the LED lights.
